address.description: Address is the address of the Consul server

datacenter.description: Datacenter to use. If not provided, the default agent datacenter is used.

password.description: Password to use for HTTP Basic Authentication

username.description: Username to use for HTTP Basic Authentication

http_auth.description: HttpAuth is the auth info to use for http access.

namespace.description: Namespace is the name of the namespace to send along for the request when no other Namespace is present in the QueryOptions

partition.description: Partition is the name of the partition to send along for the request when no other Partition is present in the QueryOptions

path_prefix.description: Prefix for URIs for when consul is behind an API gateway (reverse proxy).  The API gateway must strip off the PathPrefix before passing the request onto consul.

scheme.description: Scheme is the URI scheme for the Consul server.

address.description: Address is the optional address of the Consul server. The port, if any will be removed from here and this will be set to the ServerName of the resulting config.

ca_file.description: CAFile is the optional path to the CA certificate used for Consul communication, defaults to the system bundle if not specified.

ca_path.description: CAPath is the optional path to a directory of CA certificates to use for Consul communication, defaults to the system bundle if not specified.

ca_pem.description: CAPem is the optional PEM-encoded CA certificate used for Consul communication, defaults to the system bundle if not specified.

cert_file.description: CertFile is the optional path to the certificate for Consul communication. If this is set then you need to also set KeyFile.

cert_pem.description: CertPEM is the optional PEM-encoded certificate for Consul communication. If this is set then you need to also set KeyPEM.

insecure_skip_verify.description: InsecureSkipVerify if set to true will disable TLS host verification.

key_file.description: KeyFile is the optional path to the private key for Consul communication. If this is set then you need to also set CertFile.

key_pem.description: KeyPEM is the optional PEM-encoded private key for Consul communication. If this is set then you need to also set CertPEM.

tls_config.description: TLSConfig is used to generate a TLSClientConfig that's useful for talking to Consul using TLS.

token.description: Token is used to provide a per-request ACL token

token_file.description: TokenFile is a file containing the current token to use for this client. If provided it is read once at startup and never again.

config.description: The configuration for this ACL auth method. This should only contain primitive values and containers (such as lists and maps).

description.description: The description for this ACL auth method.

display_name.description: The display name for this ACL auth method.

max_token_ttl.description: The maximum time-to-live of the tokens this auth method produces.

name.description: The name of the ACL auth method.

namespace.description: The namespace this ACL auth method is associated with. Namespacing is a Consul Enterprise feature.

bind_namespace.description: bind_namespace is the target namespace of the binding. Can be lightly templated using HIL `${foo}` syntax from available field names. If empty it's created in the same namespace as the auth method.

selector.description: selector is an expression that matches against verified identity attributes returned from the auth method during login.

namespace_rules.description: namespace_rules apply only on auth methods defined in the default namespace. Namespacing is a Consul Enterprise feature.

partition.description: The partition this ACL auth method is associated with. Partitions are a Consul Enterprise feature.

token_locality.description: token_locality defines the kind of token that this auth method produces. This can be either 'local' or 'global'. If empty 'local' is assumed.

type.description: The type of the ACL auth method.

datacenters.description: The datacenters this ACL policy is valid in.

description.description: The description of this ACL policy.

name.description: The name of this ACL policy.

namespace.description: The namespace the ACL policy is associated with. Namespacing is a Consul Enterprise feature.

partition.description: The partition the ACL policy is associated with. Partitions are a Consul Enterprise feature.

rules.description: The rules of this ACL policy.

description.description: The description of this ACL role.

name.description: The name of this ACL role.

namespace.description: The namespace the ACL role is associated with. Namespacing is a Consul Enterprise feature.

node_name.description: The node associated with this ACL role.

node_identities.description: The nodes associated with this ACL role.

partition.description: The partition the ACL role is associated with. Partitions are a Consul Enterprise feature.

id.description: The ID of the ACL policy associated with this role.

name.description: The name of the ACL policy associated with this role.

policies.description: The policies associated with this ACL role.

service_name.description: The service associated with this ACL role.

service_identities.description: The services associated with this ACL role.

datacenters.description: The datacenters this ACL policy is valid in.

description.description: The description of this ACL policy.

name.description: The name of this ACL policy.

namespace.description: The namespace the ACL policy is associated with. Namespacing is a Consul Enterprise feature.

partition.description: The partition the ACL policy is associated with. Partitions are a Consul Enterprise feature.

rules.description: The rules of this ACL policy.
